name: Quick Baked Beef-Pasta Dish
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 1 pound pasta, such as rigatoni or penne, cooked al dente
32 ounce jar or can of your favorite spaghetti sauce

steps: Cook beef and onion in a large skillet until meat is lightly browned. Drain and sprinkle with Italian Seasoning.
In a large bowl, combine meat mixture and spaghetti sauce and mix well. Add cooked pasta and mix well.
Spray large baking dish with cooking spray.
Pat meat-pasta mixture level in baking pan.
Cover with aluminium foil, and bake in oven 20 minutes.
Remove foil, and bake uncovered another 10 minutes.
